notification.title: Campaign completed
notification.visible_text: Campaign completed — PA-5C4-U real operator campaign — Verified durable completion and result evidence are available

transcript.action: Double-click Research Supervisor.vbs using Windows Explorer semantics
transcript.visible_result: The Windows default browser displayed Research Supervisor (Research Supervisor - Google Chrome).
The visible browser status confirmed that notifications are enabled.

transcript.action: Complete New Campaign and choose Preview
transcript.visible_result: The browser showed a plain-language repository, contract, plan, task, and environment preview.
Start froze the inputs and displayed a plain-language environment action card before execution.

transcript.action: Terminate and relaunch the Custodian backend
transcript.visible_result: The launcher started a new Custodian process and preserved the frozen campaign.
Every acceptance-profile browser process exited; no page or tab substitution was used.

transcript.action: Relaunch Research Supervisor after browser termination
transcript.visible_result: A new real browser process reopened the durable blocked campaign without a run ID or shell command.
The browser explained the recoverable interruption and offered safe Resume through Continue.
The Human Action Inbox explained what happened, what was needed, and what would happen next.
The browser displayed independent evidence that the frozen authority remained intact.

transcript.action: Submit approval, choice, free-text note, and file through the UI
transcript.visible_result: The browser displayed a Campaign completed notification and verified result counts, stage, commit, reports, and summary.
The final report opened in the real browser and showed verified durable completion.
The UI visibly confirmed the downloadable ZIP result bundle.
Windows displayed the real 'Research Supervisor needs attention' dialog and kept campaign state unchanged.
